title: Green Android at Monolith
description: A glowing green android kneels at the base of a large spiraling green monolith inscribed with repeating '#10SG' text, using a tool to work on its surface. Heavy dark chains wrap around the monolith and extend into a swirling vortex in the dark blue night sky above a desolate green landscape.
prompt: A glowing green android robot kneels in the foreground working on a tall spiraling green monolith covered in repeating '#10SG' text, heavy dark metal chains wrap around the structure and spiral up into a massive swirling vortex in the dark blue night sky, desolate green wasteland with small plants and broken metal pieces at the base, atmospheric glowing particles, surreal digital painting in deep teal and emerald tones
